name: named_argument
source: theorem t (c : Cfg (input := x)) : c = c := by rfl
expected: theorem t (c : Cfg (input := x)) : c = c :=
actual: theorem t (c : Cfg (input := x)) : c = c :=

name: simple_type_let
source: theorem t : let arg := [true]; arg = arg := by rfl
expected: theorem t : let arg := [true]; arg = arg :=
actual: theorem t : let arg := [true]; arg = arg :=

name: nested_type_let
source: theorem t : let a := let b := 0; b; a = a := by rfl
expected: theorem t : let a := let b := 0; b; a = a :=
actual: theorem t : let a := let b := 0; b; a = a :=

name: proof_let_have_inline
source:
theorem t :
  let hp : 1 < 2 := by
    have := Nat.zero_lt_one; omega
  1 < 2 := by
  exact hp
expected: theorem t : let hp : 1 < 2 := by have := Nat.zero_lt_one; omega 1 < 2 :=
actual: theorem t : let hp : 1 < 2 := by have := Nat.zero_lt_one; omega 1 < 2 :=

name: proof_let_have_nested
source:
theorem t :
  let hp : 1 < 2 := by
    have h : 0 < 1 := by
      have q := Nat.zero_lt_one
      exact q
    omega
  let x := 2
  x = x := by
  rfl
expected: theorem t : let hp : 1 < 2 := by have h : 0 < 1 := by have q := Nat.zero_lt_one exact q omega let x := 2 x = x :=
actual: theorem t : let hp : 1 < 2 := by have h : 0 < 1 := by have q := Nat.zero_lt_one exact q omega let x := 2 x = x :=

name: proof_letI
source:
theorem t :
  letI : Inhabited Nat := by
    have x := 0
    exact ⟨x⟩
  True := by
  trivial
expected: theorem t : letI : Inhabited Nat := by have x := 0 exact ⟨x⟩ True :=
actual: theorem t : letI : Inhabited Nat := by have x := 0 exact ⟨x⟩ True :=

name: proof_let_same_line_have
source:
theorem t :
  let hp : True := by have h := True.intro; exact h
  True := by
  exact hp
expected: theorem t : let hp : True := by have h := True.intro; exact h True :=
actual: theorem t : let hp : True := by have h := True.intro; exact h True :=
